1. **Add lock icon buttons to each swatch** — Insert a `<button>` with inline SVG (filled lock / outline lock) in the top-right corner of each swatch. 2. **Add harmony mode selector to toolbar** — Add a `<select>` or custom dropdown in the toolbar with all 6 modes (Random, Analogous, Complementary, Triadic, Split-Complementary, Monochromatic). Wire change handler to update `state.harmonyMode` and call `generate()`. Per ui-spec.md: style with `background: #242019; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #E8E0D6`.
3. **Add L, C, 1-5 keyboard shortcuts** — Extend `handleKeydown` in `app.js` to handle: `KeyL` (toggle lock on focused/hovered swatch), `KeyC` (copy focused/hovered swatch), `Digit1-5` (focus corresponding swatch via `.focus()`). Ensure these don't fire when a toolbar control (button, select) is focused.
4. **Add CSS for lock buttons and harmony selector** — Style lock button positioning (absolute, top-right), hover/active states, and harmony dropdown per the ui-spec.md component specs.

Interactive Features

✅ All completion criteria met:

**Subtask 1 — Lock/Unlock per-color toggle: PASS**
- Each swatch has a lock icon button (top-right corner): `index.html:25-28` — `<button class="lock-btn">` in each swatch, positioned `absolute; top: var(--space-sm); right: var(--space-sm)` via `css/styles.css:247-249`
- Clicking lock toggles `palette[i].locked` in state: `js/app.js:89-98` — `handleLockClick` reads `data-index`, toggles `color.locked`, calls `render()`
- Locked icon: filled lock SVG; Unlocked: outline lock SVG: Two SVGs per swatch — `.lock-icon-unlocked` (`fill="none"`, open shackle) and `.lock-icon-locked` (`fill="currentColor"`, closed shackle). CSS toggles visibility via `.swatch.locked` class (`css/styles.css:285-295`)
- Locked colors are NOT regenerated: `js/colors.js:179` preserves locked colors, `js/app.js:63` passes `state.palette` to `generatePalette`
- Lock state visually persists: `js/app.js:42-55` — `render()` adds/removes `.locked` class and updates aria attributes each cycle
- Lock buttons have correct aria-labels: Initial `aria-label="Lock this color"` in HTML, dynamically toggled to `"Unlock this color"` when locked (`js/app.js:48-53`)

**Subtask 2 — Harmony mode selector: PASS**
- Selector visible in toolbar: `index.html:64-71` — `<select id="harmony-select">` in `.toolbar-center`
- All 6 modes listed: Random, Analogous, Complementary, Triadic, Split-Complementary, Monochromatic
- Selecting updates `state.harmonyMode`: `js/app.js:103-106` — `handleHarmonyChange` sets state and calls `generate()`
- Regenerates palette on change: `generate()` passes `state.harmonyMode` to `generatePalette()`
- Current mode visually highlighted: Native `<select>` displays selected value
- Styled to match warm dark theme: `css/styles.css:305-337` — uses correct tokens (`--color-surface` = #242019, `rgba(255,255,255,0.1)` border, `--color-text-primary` = #E8E0D6), matching ui-spec.md Harmony Mode Selector spec

**Subtask 3 — Color format toggle: PASS** (no regressions from iteration 1)

**Subtask 4 — Keyboard shortcuts: PASS**
- Spacebar generates: `js/app.js:137-141` — `Space` handler with `preventDefault()`
- L key toggles lock: `js/app.js:143-151` — uses `getActiveSwatch()` (checks focused, then hovered), toggles `locked`, calls `render()`
- C key copies color: `js/app.js:153-162` — copies formatted color of active swatch, shows toast
- Keys 1-5 focus swatches: `js/app.js:164-171` — parses digit, calls `.focus()` on matching swatch
- Tab navigates sequentially: All swatches have `tabindex="0"`
- Shortcuts guarded from toolbar: `js/app.js:130-135` — blocks on `INPUT`/`TEXTAREA`/`SELECT` tags and toolbar `BUTTON` elements

Polish & Refinement

All completion criteria met:

**Subtask 1 — Animations and micro-interactions: PASS**
- Staggered swatch transition (~80ms between each): `css/styles.css:110-114` defines delays (0, 80, 160, 240, 320ms) on `.swatch.stagger:nth-child(N)`. `js/app.js:66-74` `triggerStagger()` reflows and applies the class, called from `generate()` at line 139.
- Background-color transitions smooth (250ms ease-out): `css/styles.css:106` uses `--transition-color: 250ms ease-out` (line 50). Within spec range of 200-300ms.
- Copy pulse effect: `css/styles.css:148-156` `@keyframes copy-pulse` (scale 1 → 1.08 → 1, 200ms). `js/app.js:38-47` `addCopyPulse()` triggered on swatch click (line 161) and keyboard C (line 244).
- Lock icon bounce animation: `css/styles.css:159-167` `@keyframes lock-bounce` (scale 1 → 1.15 → 1, 200ms). `js/app.js:52-61` `addLockBounce()` triggered on lock click (line 177) and keyboard L (line 231).
- Hover brightness shift: `css/styles.css:117-133` uses `::before` pseudo-element — dark swatches get `rgba(255,255,255,0.05)` overlay, light swatches get `rgba(0,0,0,0.05)`. Swatch luminance classification at `js/app.js:93-101`. Matches ui-spec.md "subtle brightness overlay" definition.
- No animation blocks generate loop: All animations ≤250ms. CSS transitions don't block JS execution.

**Subtask 2 — Accessibility refinements: PASS**
- All buttons have descriptive aria-labels: Generate (`index.html:72`), Lock buttons (dynamically updated at `app.js:113,118` to include color index and hex), Format buttons (`index.html:79-81`), Copy All (`index.html:83`), Harmony select (`index.html:64`).
- Visible amber focus ring: `css/styles.css:462-465` applies `outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary)` (#D4913B amber) on `:focus-visible`. Mouse focus suppressed at lines 467-469.
- Screen reader announcements: `js/app.js:27-33` `announce()` writes to `#sr-announce` (`aria-live="polite"` at `index.html:92`). Copy: "Copied [value]" (lines 162, 245). Lock: "Color N locked/unlocked" (lines 178, 232). Generate: "New palette generated" (line 141).
- 44x44px touch targets: `--touch-target: 44px` applied as `min-height`/`min-width` on Generate (`styles.css:221`), Lock (`styles.css:370-371`), Format (`styles.css:342-343`), Harmony select (`styles.css:438`), Copy All (`styles.css:262`).
- Logical tab order: DOM order is swatches 0-4 (each `tabindex="0"`), then toolbar (harmony select → generate → format toggle → copy all). Matches left-to-right then toolbar.
- WCAG AA contrast: UI chrome uses theme tokens — text #E8E0D6 on #1A1614 = 12.5:1, secondary text #9C9083 on #1A1614 = 5.2:1, button text #1A1614 on #D4913B = 5.8:1. All exceed 4.5:1.
- Reduced motion: `css/styles.css:472-484` sets animation/transition to 0.01ms and removes stagger delays when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

**Subtask 3 — Copy-all palette and toolbar polish: PASS**
- Copy All button: `index.html:83-86` `<button id="copy-all-btn">` with copy SVG icon + "Copy All" text. `js/app.js:284-292` `handleCopyAll()` maps all 5 colors through `formatColor()` and joins with ", ".
- Format respects current display format: `app.js:287` uses `formatColor(c, state.colorFormat)` which switches between hex/rgb/hsl.
- Toast confirms "Palette copied!": `app.js:290`.
- Balanced toolbar layout: Desktop flexbox with `space-between`, three sections (title/center/actions) at `styles.css:170-203`. Mobile wraps with `flex-wrap: wrap` at `styles.css:497-528`, reordering center section to second row.
- Properly spaced: Desktop `gap: var(--space-md)` (16px), mobile `gap: var(--space-sm)` (8px). All elements vertically centered.
- Responsive mobile toolbar: Wraps correctly — title + actions on first row, generate + harmony on second row. Font sizes reduced for mobile (`styles.css:519-527`).

The phase is complete and meets quality standards.
